content: Current W3C WAI form guidance treats labels, grouping, instructions, validation feedback, undo/confirmation, success/error notifications, progress for long forms, and avoiding time limits where possible as broadly applicable form requirements. It calls for programmatically associated labels/names, clear status and error messages, preserved field values after errors, and live/alert regions for dynamic feedback. For this question UI, the requirements should cover keyboard and screen-reader access across all question types, focus management across question/review/dialog transitions, readable connection/error/cancellation states, and answer preservation when submission fails or the transport reconnects. This is authoritative guidance for web forms, but mapping its table-stakes level to this developer-only local UI is an informed product inference.
